title: 110 lbs (50 kg) Towel grip for 15s
summary: Lift clip of a 110 lb (50 kg) towel grip hold for 15 seconds, set to music. The description notes good towels are hard to find and that he used to do it with chains, which are more stable but less comfortable.

claims.claim: He used to do towel grip holds with chains instead of a towel: more stable but less comfortable, and a good towel for the exercise is hard to find.
